crossRefs.note: He dealt well with Abram for her sake. He had sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female…
Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.
His possessions also were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female…
So Yahweh blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels…
Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.
Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.
Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.
Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind.
Saul watched David from that day and forward.
For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.
The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will…
Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?
Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after…

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: He had possessions of flocks, possessions of herds, and a great household. The Philistines envied him.
translations.bsb: He owned so many flocks and herds and servants that the Philistines envied him.
translations.kjv: For he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied
translations.asv: And he had possessions of flocks, and possessions of herds, and a great household. And the Philistines envied him.
